summary: Volaris, the Mexican ultra-low-cost carrier, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 preliminary traffic results press release; no transaction is disclosed. Total ASMs rose 7.7% year-over-year to 3.125 billion, with international capacity up 27.5% on five new Guadalajara-U.S. routes, while domestic ASMs fell 6.8%. Consolidated load factor dropped 3.5 points to 82.4% on new-capacity ramp; passengers rose 3.0% to 2.6 million. International reached 50% of capacity. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms; operational disclosure only. Watch load-factor recovery on transborder expansion.
